evidence.title: Chinese Makers of Fentanyl Ingredients Now Sell Bootleg Peptides to Americans

occurrences.checkable_against: Anhui Rencheng Technology website
occurrences.quote_span: “We have powerful customs clearance agencies in these countries, and our customs clearance company will clear your parcel without any customs issues,” the company says.
occurrences.speaker: Anhui Rencheng Technology
occurrences.subject: Chinese fentanyl-precursor manufacturers selling peptides

occurrences.checkable_against: Online seller transaction records and patient or buyer interviews
occurrences.quote_span: While some med spas, telehealth companies and alternative doctors have been supplying unapproved peptides to patients, many Americans order directly from online sellers.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Chinese fentanyl-precursor manufacturers selling peptides

occurrences.checkable_against: CBP master-carton investigation records
occurrences.quote_span: Once in the U.S., an associate then distributes the packages inside the carton.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Chinese fentanyl-precursor manufacturers selling peptides

occurrences.checkable_against: FDA approvals database and sampled peptide product listings
occurrences.quote_span: Most of the substances being marketed as peptides are unapproved drugs.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Chinese fentanyl-precursor manufacturers selling peptides

occurrences.checkable_against: HHS and FDA marketplace-monitoring and enforcement records
occurrences.quote_span: Hilliard, the HHS spokeswoman, said the agency monitors the marketplace and has taken action against the sale of unapproved peptide products.
occurrences.speaker: Emily Hilliard
occurrences.subject: Chinese fentanyl-precursor manufacturers selling peptides

occurrences.checkable_against: Anhui Rencheng Technology website product listings
occurrences.quote_span: It is now selling a peptide known for its tanning effects, called Melanotan II, and semaglutide—the active ingredient in Ozempic—in salt form, according to its website.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Chinese fentanyl-precursor manufacturers selling peptides

occurrences.checkable_against: Alois Afilipoaie statement and TRM Labs analyst records
occurrences.quote_span: Chinese drug precursor manufacturers “have the know-how and the equipment to manufacture every single known substance on earth. And nowadays there is a lot of demand for peptides, so peptides it is,” said Alois Afilipoaie, a senior blockchain analyst at TRM.
occurrences.speaker: Alois Afilipoaie
occurrences.subject: Chinese fentanyl-precursor manufacturers selling peptides

occurrences.checkable_against: Sampled peptide product packaging and product instructions
occurrences.quote_span: The products, which are often labeled as “for research use only” or “not for human consumption,” are powdered substances that must be reconstituted with bacteriostatic water and injected.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Chinese fentanyl-precursor manufacturers selling peptides

occurrences.checkable_against: Anhui Rencheng Technology website and warehouse records
occurrences.quote_span: It says it guarantees deliveries of its products, including to the U.S., and boasts of having warehouses in the U.S., Mexico, Canada and Germany.
occurrences.speaker: Anhui Rencheng Technology
occurrences.subject: Chinese fentanyl-precursor manufacturers selling peptides

occurrences.checkable_against: Anhui Rencheng Technology website listings and medical examiner or public-health records
occurrences.quote_span: The company is also advertising a fentanyl precursor called 1-Boc-4-piperidone and a highly potent synthetic opioid called protonitazene, which is stronger than fentanyl and has caused deaths in the U.S. and elsewhere.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Chinese fentanyl-precursor manufacturers selling peptides

occurrences.checkable_against: CBP master-carton case files and intercepted shipment records
occurrences.quote_span: They take orders from buyers in the U.S. and package multiple individual orders into a larger box that is mislabeled as containing legal goods, such as snacks.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Chinese fentanyl-precursor manufacturers selling peptides

occurrences.checkable_against: TRM Labs traced cryptocurrency payment records
occurrences.quote_span: Based on crypto payments TRM has traced, the buyers of the products from these companies are both in the U.S. and elsewhere.
occurrences.speaker: TRM Labs
occurrences.subject: Chinese fentanyl-precursor manufacturers selling peptides

occurrences.checkable_against: Robert F. Kennedy Jr. public statements
occurrences.quote_span: Their purported benefits are largely anecdotal, but peptides are receiving endorsements from influencers, podcasters, alternative-medicine doctors, and even Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy, Jr., who has said he is a “big fan.”
occurrences.speaker: Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
occurrences.subject: Chinese fentanyl-precursor manufacturers selling peptides

occurrences.checkable_against: Anhui Rencheng Technology website contact details and test calls or emails
occurrences.quote_span: Several numbers and emails provided on the website are no longer in use.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Chinese fentanyl-precursor manufacturers selling peptides

occurrences.checkable_against: TRM Labs records of companies selling peptides
occurrences.quote_span: Out of those, at least 50 are currently selling peptides, a number that has been growing in recent months, said TRM.
occurrences.speaker: TRM Labs
occurrences.subject: Chinese fentanyl-precursor manufacturers selling peptides

occurrences.checkable_against: Anhui Rencheng Technology corporate website and registration records
occurrences.quote_span: Founded in 2015 in Hefei, a city northwest of Shanghai, Anhui Rencheng calls itself a professional chemistry manufacturer that prides itself “on the variety and quality of their products, which are sourced from the best possible raw materials and undergo a rigorous quality control process,” according to the website, which is in English and provides Chinese phone numbers of sales agents.
occurrences.speaker: Anhui Rencheng Technology
occurrences.subject: Chinese fentanyl-precursor manufacturers selling peptides

occurrences.checkable_against: Sampled peptide product packaging and product instructions
occurrences.quote_span: The products, which are often labeled as “for research use only” or “not for human consumption,” are powdered substances that must be reconstituted with bacteriostatic water and injected.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Chinese fentanyl-precursor manufacturers selling peptides

occurrences.checkable_against: TRM Labs company-tracking records
occurrences.quote_span: TRM Labs, one of the analytics firms, has been tracking more than 200 companies that have sold fentanyl precursors.
occurrences.speaker: TRM Labs
occurrences.subject: Chinese fentanyl-precursor manufacturers selling peptides
